text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After Biwa Hayahide wins at Hanshin<n>Racecourse,
the two of us head to a<n>hair salon rumored to be
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So this is the place City was talking<n>about...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's this salon that's super<n>popular right now.
Their slogan is, "A<n>brand new you, starting with
your<n>scalp." It's supposed to be amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Scalp cleansing changes your hair at<n>a fundamental
level, they say! Oh...<n>Whoops. It looks like they
moved. Out<n>west, to Kansai...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was shocked when I heard they had<n>moved to
Kansai, but these legs of<n>mine, which carried me to
victory,<n>have also carried me here...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The moment has come—I shall now<n>say goodbye to
my unruly hair. Wait<n>for me here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I wait for her impatiently, excited to<n>see what she'll
look like after her<n>makeover.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When I turn around, I'm pulled into a<n>world of
magical fantasy with Biwa<n>Hayahide at its center. It
looks as if<n>she has a halo over her...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I knew you'd be able to tell how<n>much my hair
quality has improved!<n>It's been tamed on an atomic
level!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That was an extraordinary head spa<n>treatment. My
hair rejoiced with each<n>new pressure point they
massaged<n>on my scalp!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Their database utilizes the latest AI<n>technology, and
they used it to create<n>a custom treatment plan for
me! I<n>have the hair of a goddess now!
choice_data_list: Sounds like you had a good time in there!
Sounds like you had a good time in there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, indeed! Words cannot describe<n>just how thrilled
I am. The whole<n>experience felt akin to victory in a
race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go and get some fresh<n>air!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She looks like a delighted child as she<n>prances off,
but after only a few<n>steps...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what in the world?! Trainer,<n>something's
wrong! My body<n>doesn't feel right!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My joints are so stiff it's as if<n>they're rusted over!
And all I did was<n>break into a light jog!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... This must be because of my<n>hair! It's
become so silky smooth that<n>my mind and body are
out of sync<n>with its reduced air resistance!
choice_data_list:
I guess you'll have to let your hair go back to the
way it was before...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What?! But then I'll have to contend<n>once more
with the unwieldy mess<n>that vexed me for so many
years!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I must construct a plan to resolve this<n>issue. I can
still figure something out<n>before my next race—it'll
just take<n>some all-nighters...
Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We notice someone crying a short<n>distance away.
It's a racer that Biwa<n>Hayahide competed against
earlier<n>today. She's shoving takoyaki into<n>her
tear-stained cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hic! I-I won't lose next time! Just youwait, Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...They told me my hair will go back to<n>the way it
was if I skip a single day of<n>treatment, so I bought a
bulk supply<n>of their product.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Could you hold on to it all for me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't. With so many rivals, I have<n>neither the time
nor the luxury to be<n>fussing over my hair.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can give it all back to me once I<n>feel like I've
finally made it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Keep those products safe for me until<n>then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide smiles, and her<n>cheerful expression
glows as<n>brilliantly as the setting sun!
